title: Raply: A profanity-mitigated rap generator
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the frequency and severity of offensive language in automatically generated rap lyrics. As part of this, it tracked specific profanity categories based on 'The Obscenity List', which included measuring the occurrence of 'religious offense' words (e.g., 'goddamn').
findings: The study found that fine-tuning a GPT-2 model on a profanity-mitigated corpus (Mitislurs) successfully reduced the overall occurrences of offensive language—including the 'religious offense' category—in the generated rap lyrics, while maintaining a high rhyme density.
